text:
ashley: Heads up — HelixHealth SI run hit a networking issue during a private deploy. bootstrap healthcheck failing, SI reports nothing listening on 10.0.4.12:8080. Need a quick architecture review + network diagram. @devin @maria can you triage? :warning:

devin: On it. can you paste the node bootstrap logs? also, is this using Azure Marketplace VNet injection or standard VNet peering?

ashley: logs:
```
ERROR: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.4.12:8080
2026-03-19T15:12:02Z - failed to fetch /internal/health
```
They're on Azure, customer requested marketplace image with VNet injection.

maria: Quick checklist to validate before we touch infra:
- NSG rules allow 8080/8443 between SI load balancer and nodes
- PrivateLink endpoints for control plane created and DNS resolving to private IPs
- Route table doesn't steer internal pod/subnet traffic to on-prem via VPN
If any of those are missing node bootstrap will fail. Can SI share NSG/security rule dump + effective routes?

paul (helix-si): adding NSG screenshot to ticket INC-8742. Confirmed NSG only allowed 443 from ALB and blocked 8080 earlier. We held off making changes until we coordinate with Redwood.

devin: If the ALB -> nodes health check uses 8080, NSG must allow that source subnet or service tag. On Azure you can scope to the ALB subnet or use service tag 'AzureLoadBalancer'. Also confirm the ALB is internal (private) vs internet-facing — that changes expected source CIDR.

partners-bot: Escalation created: ticket #INC-8742 assigned to eng-platform. Priority: P2. SLA window: 4h. https://tickets.redwood/INC-8742

ashley: Proposed next steps: 1) SI adds NSG rule to allow 8080 from ALB subnet (temporary) 2) eng-platform validates control-plane PrivateLink config + DNS 3) joint 30m architecture sync to review final routing. Can we do 09:30 PT tomorrow? @maria?

maria: Yes, I can join. Please attach NSG screenshot + route table export to the ticket before the sync. I'll bring a checklist and a minimal remediation runbook. :+1:

oncall-bot: FYI fallback option: if customer needs immediate uptime, we can stand up a short-lived Dedicated reservation for HelixHealth while networking is fixed. Coordinate with sales/finance for billing.

ashley: Thanks — I'll coordinate with Helix SI and update INC-8742 with screenshots. Will ping here when it's ready. :memo:
